summary.text: Marie Hopkins is a Republican state representative who has represented District 21 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hopkins was born in Rhode Island and earned a bachelor's degree from Brown University in 2007 and a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 2017.
